name: VinScope — API on RapidAPI
description:
Turn a VIN into a complete vehicle profile: VinScope decodes any 17-character VIN into manufacturer, model, year, body, engine and plant details — one request in, a structured vehicle record out.

What you get:
- A decoded vehicle profile from the NHTSA vPIC database: make, model, model year, body class, vehicle type and manufacturing plant
- Engine and drivetrain attributes as reported by the manufacturer filing, in named fields rather than raw codes
- Lookup endpoints for makes and models, so forms and filters can be built from the same data source
- Clean handling of partial data: attributes the source does not carry are returned as empty, never filled with guesses

Key endpoints:
- GET /decode — decode a VIN into a full vehicle profile
- GET /makes — list manufacturers
- GET /models — list models for a manufacturer

Batch / built for workflows:
VinScope fits anywhere a vehicle enters a system: used-car listings, fleet and insurance intake, parts compatibility checks, marketplace moderation. The makes/models lists let you pre-validate user input before decoding, and the single-profile response drops directly into listing templates and appraisal workflows without further lookups.

Access: subscribe on RapidAPI (free tier available); calls are made over HTTPS with your RapidAPI key.
